entries.headline: Manny Machado came close
entries.story: Manny Machado went 4-for-5 against Brady Singer and the Cincinnati Reds. Closest call was a double in the 1st: "Manny Machado doubles (21) on a sharp line drive to left fielder JJ Bleday." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Jackson Merrill stayed in the yard
entries.story: Jackson Merrill went 2-for-4 with 1 RBI against Brady Singer and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
